input.question: What is the population of Moose Lake Township, Minnesota?

documents.text: Moose Lake Township, Beltrami County, Minnesota Moose Lake Township is a township in Beltrami County, Minnesota, United States. The population was 205 as of the 2000 census. According to the United States Census Bureau, the township has a total area of 36.2 square miles (93.6 km²), of which 30.9 square miles (79.9 km²) is land and 5.3 square miles (13.7 km²) (14.63%) is water. As of the census of 2000, there were 205 people, 75 households, and 54 families residing in the township. The population density was 6.6 people per square mile (2.6/km²).
